Here are lecture 7 class notes

#filter

```{r}

chum <- read_csv("../20250730_AYKSSI_ASL_chum_export.csv")

head(chum)

tail(chum, 20)

head(chum$ABLG, 30)

filter(chum, FreshwaterWatershed == "Togiak River" | FreshwaterWatershed == "Anvik River")


filter(chum, FreshwaterWatershed %in% c("Togiak River", "Anvik River"), DNAngul >= 5)

View(chum)

filter(chum, FreshwaterWatershed == "Anvik River", AgeYRS >= 0, is.na(AgeYRS) == F)

x <- filter(chum, AgeYRS >= 0, is.na(AgeYRS) == F)
x$AgeYRS
names(chum)
```

#select

```{r}

head(select(chum, c(ABLG, FreshwaterWatershed, ExtractionPlate)),30)

```

#piping (%>%)

```{r}
chum_asl <- chum %>% 
  filter(DNAngul > 5, is.na(AgeYRS) == F) %>% 
  select(ABLG, FreshwaterWatershed, AgeYRS, Sex, LengthMM, StartLatitudeDD, StartLongitudeDD) %>%
   mutate(LengthMM/AgeYRS)

View(chum_asl)
```
